rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a hamburger or burger sandwich.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon6 bou2 baau1 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use this shortened form when the context already makes clear that you mean the burger food rather than the full 漢堡包.

example.english: The burger at this restaurant is pretty good.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅漢堡幾好食。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 hon6 bou2 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this specifically when burger means the meat patty rather than the whole sandwich.

example.english: This burger patty needs to be cooked well-done.
example.traditional: 呢塊漢堡扒要煎到全熟。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 hon6 bou2 paa4 jiu3 zin1 dou3 cyun4 suk6
